test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an example of Mass Media?
solution:
The correct answer is __**door to door campaign.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Door-to-door campaign:-**

 
 
• **It is a method of canvassing in which campaign workers go from house to house to talk to voters.**
 
• This can be done for a variety of purposes, such as to raise awareness of a cause or candidate, to collect signatures for a petition, or to register people to vote. 
 
• Door-to-door campaigns can be very effective, as they allow campaign workers to have direct conversations with voters and to learn about their concerns.
 
• However, they can also be time-consuming and challenging, as it can be difficult to get people to answer their doors or to listen to what you have to say.
 
• **It is not an example of Mass Media.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Newspapers**:-

 
 
• **These are periodicals that contain written information about current events. **
 
• They are typically published on a daily or weekly basis, and they cover a wide range of topics, including politics, business, sports, art, and science. 
 
 
 
• **Television**:-
 
 
• **It is a telecommunication system for transmitting moving images and sound from a distance. **
 
• It is a form of mass media that has had a profound impact on society. 
 
 
 
• **Radio**:-
 
 
• It is a technology that uses radio waves to transmit audio signals between two points.
 
• **It is one of the oldest and most popular forms of mass media.**
